newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan tea prices mixed on strong demand.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan tea prices mixed on strong demand.

text.p: Prices were mixed at the weekly tea auction at Mombasa on Monday as strong demand continued, auction officials said.

Brighter BP1s appreciated by 4 U.S cents, while lighter descriptions were discounted by up to 3 cents. Brighter and coloury PF1s advanced by about 3.5 cents, while a few bright Pdusts were markedly dearer by up to 10 cents. Coloury mediums were irregular, but on balance a little easier.
Fannings and BMFs were dearer. Dusts generally lost value.
Pakistan was more active, while Egypt and the Sudan remained strong.
